verdict.rationale: Qodo's pricing FAQ states plainly that it does not train models on customer code, which is used only to generate reviews, and plans list "Strict data retention." Self-managed, on-prem and air-gapped deployment options let users keep data entirely within their own infrastructure, which further prevents its use in training. Missing for 10: detailed first-party privacy or data-usage documentation (DPA or terms specifics, what "strict retention" means), coverage of non-code data such as PR chat and ticket context, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training claim.
